### 1a. Find inspection reports
SUDD documents all municipal visual inspections in reports dating back 10+ years (current to 2002). These inspection reports typically contain the following information:

- Site name and location (common name)
- Municipality and Town
- Inspection date
- Inspections type
- Time on site
- System name and location (if multiple access points are present)
- System operator name, company name, contact information
- Stipulated inspection frequency
- Local source water type
